name: Justice Defenders
mission: JUSTICE DEFENDERS PROVIDES LEGAL EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND PRACTICE WITHIN DEFENSELESS COMMUNITIES. FOUNDED IN 2007, JUSTICE DEFENDERS WORK ACROSS 35+ PRISONS IN AFRICA WHERE INCARCERATED PEOPLE AND OFFICERS TRAIN AND PROVIDE LEGAL SERVICES FOR THEMSELVES AND OTHERS.
programs: Access to Justice & Free Legal Advice
theoryOfChange: Ensure that 1,000,000 defenseless people in conflict with the law get a fair hearing by 2030.As we look forward, Justice Defenders is keen on making legal education more accessible. With the steady run of our paralegal accredited courses, we believe that many more will be equipped with legal education. In doing so, we are equipping the defenseless and ushering them into positions of influence and public authority.We will continue to awaken many more to the difficult adversarial justice systems and work with unlikely allies to reimagine justice systems within our program countries and beyond. Through radical integration, we're developing our model further to enable paralegals inside and out of prison the tools to affect system change and influence the poverty-to-prison pipeline.

strengths_deep_dive: Justice Defenders operates an innovative model focused on legal empowerment within prison systems in East Africa. By establishing law clinics inside prisons, the charity trains paralegals who provide free advice to pre-trial detainees. In 2024, reporting shows <cite id="4">30,690 imprisoned clients received free legal advice</cite>. Furthermore, the academic track has supported incarcerated individuals in pursuing University of London degrees, resulting in <cite id="4">47 law graduates</cite> in the same year.
rich_narrative.summary: Justice Defenders provides legal education and training to imprisoned communities in Africa to ensure fair access to the law. Founded in 2007, the organization trains incarcerated individuals and prison staff to act as paralegals and earn law degrees. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="2">a Total Revenue of $1,331,729</cite>, reflecting a financial contraction from $1,868,837 in FY2023. The organization maintains <cite id="1">an overall rating of 82.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. On efficiency metrics, Justice Defenders demonstrates <cite id="1">a fundraising efficiency of $0.13 per $1 raised</cite>, though its <cite id="2">program expense ratio stood at 58.5%</cite> in FY2024. Outcome records show direct services provided to thousands of individuals, including <cite id="4">30,690 clients receiving legal advice</cite> and <cite id="4">15,338 court releases</cite> documented in 2024.
